svg.title: Speculative decoding: an EAGLE-3 head guesses tokens and a big model checks them in one pass
svg.text: Speculative Decoding, One Verify Pass at a Time
An EAGLE-3 head reads Qwen3-1.7B's hidden states and guesses the next 4 tokens. Qwen3-1.7B checks all 4 in one pass and keeps them up to the first miss.
Prompt: In three sentences, explain why the sky is blue.

g.text: Qwen3-1.7B alone, on the same clock
tokens gained per pass of the big model
The same text, 64 tokens from 32 big-model passes and 1.62 times as fast with guesses. Every pass was timed on 4 CPU cores, and it plays at real speed.
